newsitem.title: UK: Pace sees Swedish GSA named soon.
newsitem.headline: Pace sees Swedish GSA named soon.

text.p: Pace Aviation Services said it hopes to appoint a Swedish general sales agent in the course of the next week.
Pace is GSA for Dublin-based Ryanair which will launch a new twice daily service between London-Stansted and Stockholm's Skavasta airport on June 12.
"There has been a tremendous interest in the service's potential," Pace managing director, Mac Warner, told Reuters in telephone interview.
"We will be selling Heathrow out of Sweden and the last departure at 2000 local (1800 gmt) -- from Skavsta -- also means delivery next morning in the UK and Ireland is possible," he added.
"Ryanair has a policy of low cost passenger fares and we will try to reflect this for cargo. We will have very competitive rates out of Sweden," he said.
Companies such as Ericsson and Saab are situated near Skavasta and are expected to find the service attractive, he said.

"Ryanair will be operating the service with Boeing 737-200s and 737-300s offering around 1.5 tonnes per flight or three tonnes daily each way," Warner added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
